summary.intent: Decide how to flip the semantic type checker (tsrs) to default-on in the Caliper Storybook addon, then respond to red CI on main and PR #428, and clean up over-engineering (excess scripts, dead code, option sprawl).
summary.outcome: Launched workers for shipping tsrs as an optional dependency (S8a), fixing the main compile break (trail #354), and two cleanup tasks (scripts/recipes trail #355, dead code trail #356). The default flip itself is held pending the user's answer on batch `extract` speed; PR #428 is blocked on the main fix.

repo: PRs #426 and #427 each passed CI alone but together broke main: crates/core/tests/semantic_join.rs builds SemanticProp/SemanticComponent by hand and lacks fields (declarations, parent, tags, composes) added by #426. Failing checks: Lint, Test / Rust, Coverage.

Checker costs: whole-project extract takes about 8 to 15 s versus 0.24 s structural on gate-large, which would invalidate the '17 to 39x faster than react-docgen-typescript' claim. Per-component queries take 25 to 45 ms for small and 0.4 to 0.5 s for large components.
Structural path has props for only 140 of 938 components on gate-large and is empty for Chakra, so the checker is the real authority.

Issue #279 was two artifacts: a process-wide peak memory (1901) read as per-tool, and 10% time-drift rule noise. The rule was already changed to summary-only; the PR added own_peak/own_metric in scripts/headline.py and made weekly.py tolerate missing metrics.
Weekly issue budgets are absolute: 2 s time and 600 MiB memory. Chakra peaks 446 to 555 MiB, about 8% headroom.
Repo script sprawl: 3,469 lines Python, 1,015 .mjs, 73 shell, 41 justfile recipes. Live scripts: weekly.py, corpora.py, headline.py, oracle_data.py, rdt.mjs, rdg.mjs.
Option sprawl: lazy, semanticTypes, semanticWaitMs, semanticWaitEmptyMs, warmUp, fillAfter; warmUp and fillAfter are off by default and used only in a parity script.

Dead code candidates: canonical-JSON read side (~380 lines), dead Supervisor restart code in tsc-client (~75 lines), unused napi exports session_stats/JsLazyStats, 360 lines of source-text scanning in architecture.rs. ADR 0002 mandates manual Serialize impls, so keep the Serialize side.
Since Nov 7: 155 commits, production Rust +10k/-2.5k, Rust tests +15.7k (about 1.6x production), fixtures +19.6k.

code.finding: Test initializers for SemanticProp and SemanticComponent are missing fields added in PR #426; fix with a shared test helper so future field additions break in one place.

workflow: Merged-state testing is missing: parallel PRs passed alone and broke together. Remedy: require branches up to date before merge or use a merge queue.
One worker per finding with a full clean-room reinstall is costly; batch findings per branch and run the clean-room reinstall only on the last PR of a stack, since CI already does it.
User rule saved to memory: no new scripts without a named caller (CI, weekly, or regularly-run recipe); keep scratch outside the repo in ~/Projects/caliper-fixtures/.
Memory path note: the saved memory went to the caliper project memory dir, a different path from the one in the session instructions.

friction: Main is red from the combined #426/#427 merge, so lint, tests and coverage fail on every branch cut from it, including #428.
The user spotted #428's failing checks before the assistant had reported them.
The user's 'no more addon?' was ambiguous, requiring a clarification about the opt-in flag versus the Storybook addon itself.
The assistant's own process (a worker per finding, scripts written for single investigations) created the sprawl the user then asked to clean up.
open_items: Decision pending from the user: default checker on only for per-component surfaces (keeping batch extract structural unless --checker) versus on everywhere with a rewritten speed claim.
Merge main into #428 after the fix/main-semantic-join fix lands; update the cleanup branches too.
Decide on merge queue or require-up-to-date branch protection.
Re-scope S7c to a syntax-only fallback (names, required, JSDoc, defaults from oxc, types opaque with degradedBy) and defer S7f (Windows ARM64).
Delete warmUp/fillAfter after the prefetch spike decision; stop adding options unless one replaces an old one.
Ship tsrs as an @tsrs/<platform> optional dependency (S8a) with install-size smoke tests (23 to 50 MB per platform).
First-paint budget on big libraries (about 0.4 to 0.5 s cold, trail #333) is undecided.
Cleanup workers #355 and #356 still need to report before/after line counts; they must prove byte-identical output on a construct fixture and gate-large.
Add an AGENTS.md rule: no new script without a caller.
